chunks: He said: "I am a servant of God; He gave me the Book and made me a prophet."
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Mary say about his role and the book he received?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Maryam, Prophet Isa (Jesus) speaks from the cradle, a unique miracle affirming his prophethood immediately after birth. He emphasizes his dual status as a humble servant ('Abdullah) and a chosen messenger, having been granted the Injil (Gospel) and wisdom from a young age. This declaration underscores the Shia theological emphasis on the purity and divine selection of the prophets, counting Isa among the Ulul 'Azm (Prophets of Determination).
